# Galaxy Nails Spa

> Nail salon & spa pedicures based in Round Rock, Texas. Acrylics, solar and SNS dip, gel, spa pedicures and detailed nail art on Gattis School Rd, from a friendly team Round Rock regulars have trusted since 2019.

- Phone: (512) 373-3703
- Based in: Round Rock, TX
- Nearby areas: Round Rock, Pflugerville, Hutto, Georgetown, Austin, Cedar Park
- Google rating: 4.6 from 521 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/galaxy-nails-spa/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/galaxy-nails-spa/book.html

## Services
- Acrylic sets & refills: Full sets and fills in any shape and length, from soft pink ombre to bold glitter tips.
- Solar & SNS dip: Solar and dipping powder sets in natural, color, pink and white or ombre.
- Spa pedicures: From a classic pedicure to hot stone, Dr. Teal's, milk and honey and fresh orange.
- Nail art & 3D designs: Hand-painted florals, 3D flowers, chrome, charms and rhinestones, matched to your inspiration photo.
- Gel, Gel-X & builder gel: Glossy gel color, Gel-X extensions and builder gel that grows out clean, without lifting.
- Manicures & French tips: Classic and hot stone manicures, crisp French tips and kids manicures for little ones.

## About
Galaxy Nails Spa has been doing nails in Round Rock since 2019, in the shopping center at 2051 Gattis School Rd, Suite 510. We're open seven days a week and walk-ins are welcome. We love Round Rock, and that's why we're here. Our regulars say it best: some have been coming in for more than five years, and they come back for the people as much as the nails. Clients ask for Lyana, Lina, Jennifer and Cyndy by name, and say the whole team is patient, accommodating and loves a good laugh. Nextdoor neighbors named us a Neighborhood Favorite in 2024 and 2025. Bring an inspiration photo, a wedding date or a holiday idea. From a clean French or builder gel to a full set of 3D flowers and gold chrome, or a fresh orange pedicure with a hot stone massage, we'll take the time to get it exactly how you want it.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday 10 a.m. to 7 p.m., and Sunday 11:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Call (512) 373-3703 to check holiday hours.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome seven days a week. To skip the wait, call ahead or book a time.
- Q: How much is a pedicure?
  A: A classic pedicure is $35 and a hot stone pedicure is $45. Our Dr. Teal's, milk and honey and fresh orange spa pedicures run $60 to $65. See the full menu on our Services page.
- Q: Do you do kids' nails?
  A: Yes. Kids under 9 can get a manicure, a pedicure or both.
- Q: Can I bring a picture of the nails I want?
  A: Yes, please do. Inspiration photos help your tech match the shape, color and art you have in mind.
- Q: Where are you located?
  A: 2051 Gattis School Rd #510, Round Rock, TX 78664, in the shopping center on Gattis School Rd.
